title: Official engine job runner
summary: Validate package job descriptions, stage only requested assets, bind questions/plans/runs to exact execution authority, and distinguish finished evidence from mere process entry.

carrier.notes: Gate execution_id is execution_ plus the first 32 hex characters of SHA-256 over canonical product/account/session/root-turn/turn/capability/resource-scope data. Scope includes project_revision and authorization context. A proven-not-started step terminalizes RELEASED; the identical request replays its failed outcome, rather than running again.

replaceability.why: The sealed dispatcher, execution broker or sandbox is trusted integrity machinery.

reach.notes: Trusted Runtime seam, not an additional grant to a creator Luc.

operations.name: engine_job_from
operations.notes: No fixed operation deadline is enforced; the enclosing authorized sandbox profile supplies its execution ceiling. Checks declared fields, plain names, needs/source kinds, source count, artifact/produces/plan, and trusted callbacks. Full Python callable representation is draft.

operations.name: engine_question_from
operations.notes: No fixed operation deadline is enforced; the enclosing authorized sandbox profile supplies its execution ceiling. Request and scope must be plain JSON objects; only declared machine needs are allowed. Returns EngineQuestion dataclass projected as an object.

operations.name: stage_source
operations.notes: No fixed operation deadline is enforced; the enclosing authorized sandbox profile supplies its execution ceiling. Verified private copies only; source kind comes from content type. Multiple staging copies are not an atomic durable Project write or revision advance. Full EngineJob input projection is draft.

operations.name: artifact_is_ready
operations.notes: No fixed operation deadline is enforced; the enclosing authorized sandbox profile supplies its execution ceiling. Manifest requires status ready, not mere existence; without manifest, produced file must exist and be nonempty.

operations.name: read_artifact
operations.notes: No fixed operation deadline is enforced; the enclosing authorized sandbox profile supplies its execution ceiling. Missing/malformed manifest can raise built-in exceptions. A non-ready manifest uses dynamic <label>_incomplete. Finite returned-code set and opaque job input await package specialization.

operations.name: bind_engine_question
operations.notes: No fixed operation deadline is enforced; the enclosing authorized sandbox profile supplies its execution ceiling. Returns a sealed runner, not execution output. Job execution writes declared scratch artifacts and keeps the request Project revision. A ready artifact with lost receipt is UNKNOWN; otherwise NOT_EXECUTED. Media import or notes follow through their own governed writes. No client_op_id atomic Project commit here. Exact callable/input projection is draft.

invariants.text: Job artifacts must be declared before process entry; staging copies and scratch output do not themselves change durable Project revision.
For governed calls, a definitive no-side-effect failure is RELEASED and the identical execution identity replays that failure. A new attempt must not be disguised as a retry.

break: An unhandled exception, invalid output, or failed declared artifact check.
failure.notes: The original reports failure today. The self-Luc run gate and original fallback are requirements for a future replacement, not a promise this seam already implements.

conformance.notes: Only contract/schema checking exists here; no replacement conformance runner.

known_deviations.text: Job request/finish/plan are Python callbacks and errors include label-derived codes; a closed JSON replacement protocol does not exist today.
Process success is separate from subsequent media import or notes writes; the full job is not one atomic client_op_id Project commit.
The execution journal stores immutable effect results separately from Project persistence. It does not make the Project document, revision and client_op_id result record one atomic commit.

job_spec.description: Python package spec: request/finish/check and optional plan are trusted callables, sources can be a callable over declared Project reads. This is not a serializable wire shape.
